claims.note: Accurate structural characterization; Sec. 1 contains only the citation.

claims.claim: Directs the Secretary of Veterans Affairs, within 30 days of enactment, to seek an agreement with the National Academies to study the prevalence and mortality of cancers among covered individuals.
claims.sourceSpan: Not later than 30 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall seek to enter into an agreement with the National Academies

claims.claim: The Secretary must finalize the agreement within 60 days of entering negotiations.
claims.sourceSpan: The Secretary shall finalize the agreement under paragraph (1) by not later than 60 days after the date on which the Secretary enters negotiations

claims.claim: If not, the Secretary must report to the Senate and House Veterans' Affairs Committees explaining the delay.
claims.sourceSpan: submit to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs of the Senate and the Committee on Veterans' Affairs of the House of Representatives a report
claims.note: 'explaining the delay' = report (I) 'an explanation of the reasons the Secretary failed to satisfy such requirement'.

claims.claim: Must give a briefing at least every 60 days until it is finalized.
claims.sourceSpan: not less frequently than once every 60 days after the date on which the Secretary failed to satisfy such requirement
claims.note: 'at least every 60 days' = 'not less frequently than once every 60 days'.

claims.claim: 'Covered individual' means a person who served on active duty in the Army, Navy, Air Force, or Marine Corps as an aircrew member of a fixed-wing aircraft (pilot, navigator, weapons systems operator, or other regular crew).
claims.sourceSpan: means an individual who served on active duty in the Army, Navy, Air Force, or Marine Corps as an aircrew member of a fixed-wing aircraft
claims.note: Roles (pilot, navigator, weapons systems operator, aircraft system operator, other regular crew) enumerated in (d); analysis compresses 'aircraft system operator' into 'other regular crew' — faithful.

claims.claim: Requires the study to identify occupational exposures and review associations with overall cancer morbidity and mortality and 11 specified cancers.
claims.sourceSpan: review the literature to determine associations between exposures referred to in paragraph (1) and the incidence or prevalence of overall cancer morbidity, overall cancer mortality

claims.claim: The named cancers are brain; colon and rectal; kidney; lung; melanoma skin; non-Hodgkin lymphoma; pancreatic; prostate; testicular; thyroid; and urinary bladder.

claims.note: All 11 lettered cancers match verbatim.

notes: Study-type bill (2 sections, ~4.8K chars source, full read). Bill orders a National Academies study of cancer prevalence/mortality among active-duty fixed-wing aircrew. All figures (30-day agreement deadline, 60-day finalization deadline, recurring 60-day briefings, 11 named cancers), entities (Secretary of VA, National Academies, VA/DoD/Services databases, National Death Index/NCHS/CDC, section 750 NDAA FY2021 study Public Law 116-283), and directions verified against source. Zero material issues. Minor open rows are editorial glosses/framing not present in source ('independent', 'low-cost', 'aircrew study', 'no recorded opposition') plus sponsor/cosponsor metadata (permitted structural per rubric class 8) and one minor omission (report completion-date estimate). No referencedSources registered and none needed — the section 750 reference is self-contained in the primary bill text; no external figures pulled. Featured CR quote (Mr. Pfluger) not verifiable from bill text (no CR source file) and out of decompose scope.
